description: The chart illustrates the distribution of three categories - Context, Generated Response, and Other - across two groups, "Ours" and "Standard". The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as Context, Generated Response, and Other, and is color-coded with blue, orange, and green, respectively. The vertical axis is labeled with the two groups, "Ours" and "Standard", and is not explicitly scaled. For each group, the categories are stacked horizontally, with the Context category represented by a blue bar, Generated Response by an orange bar, and Other by a green bar. In the "Ours" group, the Context bar is approximately 60.6% long, the Generated Response bar is around 31.7% long, and the Other bar is about 7.7% long. In the "Standard" group, the Context bar is approximately 23.6% long, the Generated Response bar is around 51.1% long, and the Other bar is about 25.3% long. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the distribution of the three categories across the two groups.
